log.text: Scope check: Northwind Commercial rules on file, 9 days left in the window
Gathered the SOP and insurer policy, the case record (2 documents, 2 notes) and 1 team-knowledge entry (KB-0002)
Asked claude-opus-5-5 for the next step
Reading the denial and where the case stands
Checking each insurer requirement against the records
Flagging what needs a person's judgment
Model's pick: Resubmit with documentation · no escalation triggers
Safety checks passed: citations, escalation rules, draft

result.situation: CASE-1101: Dupixent PA for adult atopic dermatitis, PENDED by Northwind on 2026-10-13 (CLIN-INFO: severity not documented; IGA or BSA requested). The office faxed 10/15 chart notes with IGA 4 and BSA 22% on 2026-10-16. The window closes 2026-10-27 23:59, with 206 hours left. This is submission 1.

criteria.evidence: 10/15/2026 chart note documents IGA 4 and BSA 22%.

criteria.criterion: 2. Prescriber is a dermatologist, allergist or immunologist
criteria.evidence: Prescriber is Dr. Lena Brooks, Dermatology.

criteria.criterion: 3a. Medium-to-super-high-potency topical corticosteroid ≥28 consecutive days with documented outcome
criteria.evidence: PA form lists mometasone furoate 0.1% ointment, 01/12/2026–03/02/2026, outcome inadequate. Policy asks for chart-note documentation, which we do not hold. The payer did not flag this criterion.

criteria.criterion: 3b. Topical calcineurin inhibitor ≥28 consecutive days with documented outcome
criteria.evidence: PA form lists tacrolimus 0.1% ointment, 03/05/2026–05/20/2026, outcome inadequate. Supporting chart notes are not in our file. The payer did not flag this criterion.

criteria.criterion: 4. Not used with another biologic or JAK inhibitor for AD
criteria.evidence: PA form states no concurrent biologic or JAK inhibitor.

missing_information.item: Chart notes documenting the mometasone and tacrolimus trials (drug, dates, outcome)
missing_information.why_it_matters: Policy says trials must be documented in chart notes. We only hold the PA form, so a later ST-DOC denial is possible.
missing_information.how_to_get: Optional parallel request to Bayview Skin Clinic. Do not delay the resubmission for it.

E1.reason: No contraindication, intolerance, lab or off-label dosing question. Severity scores are stated directly in DOC-1101-02.

E2.reason: CASE, DOC-1101-01, DOC-1101-02 and NOTE-1/NOTE-2 agree on diagnosis, trials and severity.

E3.reason: No claimed rule change affects this case. KB-0002 (triamcinolone tip) is irrelevant here, since no triamcinolone was used. POLICY bulletin NW-B-2026-09 reports no changes.

E4.reason: 206 hours remain per system facts (not under 48h), and we already hold the requested IGA/BSA (DOC-1101-02).

E5.reason: CASE shows submission_count 1 and a pend, not a second denial.

E6.reason: No patient safety concern appears in CASE, DOC-1101-01, DOC-1101-02 or the notes.

result.action_rationale: The pend is CLIN-INFO for severity (CASE). Per SOP §5, we resubmit when we already hold the information, and DOC-1101-02 documents IGA 4 and BSA 22%, satisfying POLICY criterion 1. No escalation trigger fires, and the 14-day pend window has 206 hours left.
parallel_actions: Optionally ask Bayview Skin Clinic for chart notes documenting the mometasone and tacrolimus trials, to head off a future ST-DOC denial.
Log the criteria checklist and resubmission in case notes per SOP §4 step 6.
could_not_determine: Whether Northwind will accept the PA-form trial details without underlying chart notes.
needs_human_judgment: Whether to also request step-therapy chart notes now or wait for the payer's response.

draft.to: Northwind Health Plan – Pharmacy Prior Authorization
draft.subject: CASE-1101 – Dupixent PA pended for severity: IGA/BSA documentation attached
draft.body:
Re: CASE-1101, patient ref PT-64102, Dupixent (dupilumab) 300 mg q2w for moderate-to-severe atopic dermatitis. Prescriber: Dr. Lena Brooks, Dermatology, Bayview Skin Clinic.

This request was pended on 2026-10-13 for missing severity documentation (IGA or BSA). Attached is the 10/15/2026 chart note documenting IGA 4 and BSA 22%. This meets the severity criterion in policy NW-RX-2207 (IGA ≥3 or BSA ≥10%).

The step-therapy trials (mometasone furoate 0.1% ointment and tacrolimus 0.1% ointment, both inadequate) and the absence of concurrent biologic or JAK inhibitor use are documented on the original request.

Please resume review. Thank you.

Forus Access Operations

then: Attach the 10/15 chart note and submit.
